title: M9-C42.21 — Milestone M21.6 Survivor Intelligence Report
methodology: Per-engine survivor classification into A (genuine behavioral gap), B (equivalent mutant), C (intentional/unreachable), D (infrastructure/discovery), E (ambiguous). Classification based on diff analysis of captured mutants, cross-referenced with M9-C42.17 inventories (pilot engines), coverage data, and test inventory. For new engines, classification is pattern-based with explicit confidence. Not_checked=0 for all components.

summary.classification_note: Counts are from C42.21 execution; M9-C42.17 pilot inventories had slightly different survivor totals (stale counts per C42.19 R4) but classification patterns are carried forward where applicable.

Key pattern: boundary-value mutations in interest/fee calculations survive as equivalent (B); some comparison flips are genuine gaps (A) where tests don't assert strict inequality.

cross_component_patterns.implication: Discovery gap: coverage lines touched but no direct test-to-mutant binding.
Property tests assert invariants, not exact values → high survival rate is expected; genuine gaps vs equivalent mutants indistinguishable without stronger properties.
Mutations in rounding, comparison, boundary operators often equivalent under domain contracts.
5 mutants flip between runs; root cause = Hypothesis fast profile + timing jitter. Documented in variance artifact.

recommended_actions.action: Eliminate no_tests gap (2835 mutants) by adding direct unit/property tests for uncovered functions; then re-mutate to separate A vs B.
Strengthen property tests (add exact-value assertions, boundary properties) or add unit tests; current 4 property tests insufficient for mutation discrimination.
Target 26 kills from ~43 genuine gaps to reach 80%; focus on interest/fee boundary assertions.
Add direct tests for the 29 no_tests utility functions; strengthen lineage_walker property tests.
Add boundary-value tests for percentage_change and parse_amount_paise to convert B→A where genuine.
Add threshold-boundary unit tests for the 40 estimated genuine gaps.
Add dedicated unit tests (currently 0 direct tests) to reduce equivalent/survivor ambiguity.
Stabilize non-determinism: derandomize Hypothesis mutation profile or pin seeds for CI.
